title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the People's Court Shall Accept Labor Dispute Cases Where the Labor Arbitration Committee Fails to Make an Arbitration Award Within the Time Limit or Issues a Notice of Non-acceptance

articles.content_en:
Sichuan Higher People's Court:
Your request No. Chuan Gao Fa [1998] 52, "Request for Instructions on Whether a People's Court Shall Accept a Labor Dispute Case Prosecuted by a Party without Prior Labor Arbitration", has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:
In accordance with the spirit of Article 79 of the Labor Law of the People's Republic of China, arbitration by the labor dispute arbitration commission shall be a prerequisite for prosecution of a labor dispute case. Where the labor dispute arbitration commission fails to make an arbitration award within the time limit or makes a decision of non-acceptance, and the party is dissatisfied and prosecutes an administrative action with a People's Court, the People's Court shall not accept such action; where the party is dissatisfied with the labor dispute arbitration award made by the labor dispute arbitration commission, the party may institute a civil action with a People's Court.
This is hereby replied.
